domain-information: A Pilot reviews the flight plan and requests clarification from operations before departure.
A Pilot reports an in-flight technical irregularity to maintenance after landing.
An Operations Coordinator assigns a pilot, flight attendants and an aircraft pilot to a flight plan.
An Operations Coordinator issues a disruption notice to customer service when delays exceed a threshold.
A Maintenance Engineer performs an inspection and updates the aircraft’s maintenance record.
A Maintenance Engineer addresses a reported technical issue and releases the aircraft back into service.
A Maintenance Engineer flags an aircraft for extended maintenance and notifies operations to reassign flights.
A Customer Service Agent assists passengers with rebooking options after a disruption notice.
A Customer Service Agent processes a check-in of a passenger.
A Customer Service Agent coordinates with baggage services to locate and forward missing luggage.

domain objects.name: Pilot
domain objects.description: Certified flight crew member responsible for operating an aircraft.

domain objects.name: Flight Plan
domain objects.description: Operational document defining aircraft, crew, route, and timing.

domain objects.name: Aircraft
domain objects.description: Air vehicle assigned to flights and subject to maintenance.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Record
domain objects.description: Historical log of inspections, repairs, and technical actions on an aircraft.

domain objects.name: Flight Attendant
domain objects.description: Cabin crew member assigned to passenger operations on a flight.

domain objects.name: Clarification Request
domain objects.description: Pilot’s request for operational clarification regarding a flight plan.

domain objects.name: Irregularity Report
domain objects.description: Pilot-submitted report describing a technical irregularity encountered during flight.

domain objects.name: Operations Coordinator
domain objects.description: Staff member responsible for crew assignment, aircraft allocation, and operational coordination.

domain objects.name: Disruption Notice
domain objects.description: Notification sent to customer service when operational delays or issues occur.

domain objects.name: Customer Service Agent
domain objects.description: Agent assisting passengers with check-in, rebooking, and baggage issues.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Engineer
domain objects.description: Technician performing aircraft inspections, repairs, and technical assessments.

domain objects.name: Inspection
domain objects.description: Maintenance activity evaluating the condition of an aircraft.

domain objects.name: Maintenance Extension Notification
domain objects.description: Alert indicating that an aircraft requires extended maintenance time.

domain objects.name: Rebooking Options
domain objects.description: Possible alternative travel arrangements offered to passengers.

domain objects.name: Check In
domain objects.description: Process of registering a passenger for a flight and issuing travel documents.

domain objects.name: Baggage Services
domain objects.description: Unit responsible for handling, locating, and forwarding passenger luggage.

associations.description: Operations Coordinator assigns crew and aircraft to the Flight Plan.
Pilot reviews and prepares for the Flight Plan.
Clarification Request is sent to the Operations Coordinator.
Operations Coordinator issues a Disruption Notice.
Disruption Notice is received by the Customer Service Agent.
Maintenance Engineer evaluates the Irregularity Report.
Inspection is conducted on the Aircraft.
Maintenance Engineer updates the Maintenance Record.
Maintenance Engineer creates a Maintenance Extension Notification.
Maintenance Extension Notification is sent to the Operations Coordinator.
Customer Service Agent processes the Check In.
Passenger participates in the Check In.
Customer Service Agent provides Rebooking Options.
Rebooking Options are offered to the Passenger.
Customer Service Agent coordinates with Baggage Services.
